name: Starlink Group 15-23
slot_a_text: B1063 on its 35th flight. Perfect 34 for 34 on landings. Last flew Starlink Group 17-53 28 days ago. Targeting OCISLY, 574 km downrange.
slot_b_text: B1063 has flown 34 times over 69 months. Its flights break down as 25 Starlink, three NROL, one Transporter, and five others. Its quickest turnaround was 32 days. Only one cores in the fleet have flown more.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: Ion thrusters used on satellites produce about as much force as the weight of a single sheet of paper.
